name: Project WAND: Haunting Desires
source:
The protagonist Alexis and her witchy (and pretty bitchy) friend Shin are trapped in a haunted mansion together! There, they'll encounter puzzles and the other Project WAND girls in an adventure full of steamy tsundere sex, skimpy Halloween outfits and tasty gocks.
